levels.surface: عبد الرحمن بن سعد بن عمار بن سعد

notes: «حدثني أبي عن أبيه عن جده» gives three bare kinship words: each is a relation link with no name in the text (rule 7)
«مؤذن رسول الله» describes Abd al-Rahman's office; it is not part of his name (rule 1)
The grandfather relays the Prophet's order to Bilal, so he is the last link; the Prophet is not a link
